2-Track Aluminium Sliding Window — Design, Height Options & Technical Details

  • Need mesh included? → 3-track sliding window
  • Domal / 27×65 budget? → Domal window price

Slim 2-track aluminium sliding windows for everyday entrances and high-traffic openings. Match series to height (about 7–14 ft across S29–S40). Most slim/luxury lines use a 14 mm interlock with high-safety glass and quality locks. Use the S29 live calculator for a size-based estimate, or see the 2-track French sliding door for full door openings. Specs and height bands are in the feature table below.

Room / size examples (planning band)

  • Bedroom 5×4 ft (~20 sqft) — 6 mm clear: roughly ₹24,000–28,000 before GST.
  • Living / balcony 6×4 ft (~24 sqft) — DGU or multipoint lock: roughly ₹29,000–40,000 before GST.

Technical Specifications — 2-Track Aluminium Sliding Window

2-track aluminium sliding window — features and specifications
FeatureDetail
Windows typeSliding windows (2-track)
Materials typeAluminium profiles
Aluminium alloy6063-T6
BrandsVitoc, Hindalco, Jindal
Color typePowder coated — unlimited colour options including wooden powder coating; Anodizing — limited colours
Powder coating brandsExterior grade (AkzoNobel / Zotun)
Finish optionsSmooth colour, textured colour, wooden finish
Waterproofing / dust proofingYes — strong water and dust proofing
SoundSound resistance generally reduces noise by about 25–35 dB
Hardwares / lockingConcealed lock, key lock; multipoint lock upgrade ₹3,000 per window (touch / metro / lever types)
Interlock14 mm interlock common on slim and luxury 2-track lines
Series-compatible height optionsS29 / S30 / S31 — about 7 ft; S34 / S35 / S38 — about 10 ft; S40 / 14 mm high-end — about 14 ft (this product’s calculator is S29)
Glass guidanceSingle toughened commonly 6–12 mm; DGU typically up to ~30 mm (S34–S38) or ~34 mm (S40); high-safety / laminated on suitable high-end series
RollersUp to ~80 kg per panel; keep shutter width at least half of height for smooth glide

Typical use: entrances and high-use openings. Mesh is on the 3-track sliding window. Frame warranty 10 years; hardware 5 years; coating and glass as per manufacturer terms.

Price & Cost Breakup (2-Track)

Sliding window cost factors for the S29 calculator:

  • Frame: ₹850–1,050/sq.ft (premium 29 mm profiles)
  • Glass: 6 mm included; upgrades 8/10/12 mm, DGU, safety as listed in the calculator
  • Coating: Texture/smooth included; wooden +₹50/sq.ft
  • Hardware: Single-point included; multipoint lock +₹3,000 per window

₹1,200–1,400/sqft is a configured planning band before GST. Package cards use 8mm clear only (~₹1,020–1,050/sqft on larger sizes). Example 6×4 ft (24 sq.ft) with 6 mm + single lock: about ₹28,000–32,000 before GST — use the live calculator for your size.

FAQs

A 2-track aluminium sliding window has two horizontal tracks so panels slide side to side. It is typically used at entrances and other high-use openings. Common series include S29, S30, S31, S34, S35, S38, and S40. Most slim and luxury windows use a 14 mm interlock and work with high-safety glass and quality locks. This calculator covers the S29 (29 mm) premium series.
S29, S30, and S31 are most compatible up to about 7 ft. S34, S35, and S38 typically suit openings up to about 10 ft. S40 / 14 mm high-end series can reach about 14 ft height on suitable projects. Always confirm the exact opening with a site measure.
2-track systems support high-safety glass and locks. Mid series such as S34, S35, and S38 commonly take DGU up to about 30 mm and give better sound control with safety glass. S40 / 14 mm high-end lines commonly take DGU up to about 34 mm and can run high-safety glass such as 15 mm laminated. Exact glass depends on the profile pocket and project brief.
Most slim and luxury 2-track aluminium sliding windows use a 14 mm interlock type for a cleaner sightline and a more premium meet of the shutters.
From the S29 (29 mm) system series upward, vibration is far better controlled on larger sizes when hardware (wheels, rails, seals) is complete. Below that class, vibration is more likely on large openings. Match series to height: about 7 ft for S29–S31, about 10 ft for S34–S38, and up to about 14 ft for S40 high-end.
Keep each sliding shutter’s width at least half of its height. That keeps the wheels balanced and the slide soft for the life of the window.
Premium S29 (29 mm) 2-track typically plans at ₹1,200–1,400/sqft before GST for common upgrades. Standard 8mm clear packages can show ~₹1,020–1,050/sqft on larger sizes (base glass only). Multipoint lock is ₹3,000 per window. Mesh is on the 3-track version. Budget Domal starts around ₹550/sqft. Use the live calculator for your exact size.
